draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.10, the 132nd-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 16th of 32 at WR. He lasted until pick 187, well after his grade rank (132nd): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Terrace Marshall. Testing concerns: 10-yard split (12th percentile), vertical jump (0th percentile). College production: 538 receiving yards in 2022, 26th of 32 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Houston Texans. 34 career games and 23 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 5 AV in 2025 against a career-best 5 in 2024. Strengths in 2025: yards per target 12.0 (99th percentile), catch rate 71.7% (88th percentile), drop rate 2.2% (84th percentile). Weak spots: yards after catch per reception 1.1 (0th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 wide receiver who played: 551 receiving yards against a median of 346, above the norm.
